notes: A refused photo no longer kills the turn. When the vision model's filter blocks a reply the character now answers without the picture instead of saying nothing at all — the text model moderates far looser than the vision model, so the same conversation that was refused with a photo attached goes through without one. The character is told the photo did not come through and to ask about it rather than invent what it saw, and the photo itself is not sent anywhere new. This already worked when a self-hosted vision endpoint was down; it now covers a provider refusal too, which was the more common way a photo ended up sitting in the thread with no reply.
